facts.fact: The federal communications ministry commissioned the first of 3,700 sites under the Nigeria Universal Communication Access Project at Bende, Abia State, to bring broadband to unserved and underserved rural and riverine communities, with the Universal Service Provision Fund named in support.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy; Universal Service Provision Fund

NGA.note: Minister says the President made resources available to buy the towers, but no amount, budget line or fund account is given.
